description: Turn an offer into a shipped landing page with section architecture chosen by offer type and awareness level, a first screen that repeats the ad's promise word for word, a deployable build (single-file HTML or Next.js) with A/B variant routes, and an optional deploy; includes a teardown mode that scores any live page section-by-section into a prioritized rewrite plan (the conversion-audit capability), and a local section for service businesses (call-first page vs quote form vs booking, plus a phone first-screen checklist). Use when the user wants a page built, has approved copy that needs to become a working page, has ads that get clicks but no sign-ups or calls, or has a live page that isn't converting.
